mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpIvMultiDeliveryPopList*/ SELECT TO_CHAR(A.CD_QTY,'FM999,999,999,999,999.000') AS CD_QTY , SUBSTR(A.CD_DATE,1,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(A.CD_DATE,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(A.CD_DATE,7,2) AS CD_DATE , NVL(B.INV_QTY,0) AS INV_QTY FROM ICOMPORS A, ICOMIVDT B WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND A.PO_SEQ = #{st_po_seq} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER(+) AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO(+) AND A.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ(+) AND A.DS_DATE= B.DS_DATE(+) AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS(+) <> 'D'
